facts.fact: Under new regulations released 5 November 2026, the Central Bank of Nigeria oversees stablecoins used for payments, transfers, FX conversion and settlement, and firms must apply to it for authorisation (with NGN 1 billion extra capital) to offer these services, per TechCabal.
